webster.text: A teacher of children; one whose occupation is to instruct young children; a schoolmaster.

example.quote: From the positive, and dogmatic manner, in which this author delivers his opinions, and answers objections made to his sentiments — one would conclude, that he was some pedantic pedagogue who had been accustomed to deliver his dogmas to pupils, who always placed implicit faith in what he delivered.
example.cite: Brutus IX, New York Journal, Jan. 17, 1788
